newsitem.title: USA: Summit authorizes increase of 130mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Summit authorizes increase of 130mln shares.

text.p: Summit Bancorp said Friday that shareholders at the company's annual meeting, voted to increase the company's authorized common stock from 130 million shares to 260 million shares.
The company said the additional stock will be available for acquisitions, stock splits and dividends, raising new equity capital, benefit plans or other corporate purposes.

The company also said that it will continue to look to acquire profitable institutions that have a good geographic fit with its existing franchise. The company has a merger pending with Collective Bancorp that is pending.
